Paginated history of **content_change** detections for the monitor. Each row includes `diffSummary` with `changeCategory` derived from server `CHANGE_CATEGORY_SMALL_MAX` / `CHANGE_CATEGORY_MEDIUM_MAX` (total diff lines). JSON uses camelCase (e.g. `snapshotBeforeId`). See shared constants `monitor-change-categories.ts` for default thresholds when mirroring filters in clients.
